# Voprosy Metodologii

> A digital archive of the Russian methodological journal Voprosy Metodologii (1991–1999): 15 issues, 2,274 scanned pages, OCR texts and Markdown tables of contents.

## About

Archive of the journal founded by G. P. Shchedrovitsky, published by the Moscow Methodological Circle (MMK). Covers activity theory, SMD-methodology, pedagogy, organizational-activity games (ODI), systems approach and hermeneutics. Spanning 1991–1999 (1993 is missing).

- Author: [Maxim Osovsky](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q107189449)
- URL: https://github.com/maximosovsky/voprosy-metodologii
- License: CC BY-SA 4.0
- Total articles: 201

## For LLMs: How to use this archive

This repository is designed to be LLM-friendly. Here is how to work with it:

### 1. Search for articles by author, title, or year

Use `search-index.json` — a structured catalog of all 201 articles with metadata:
- Fields: year, issue folder, section, authors, title, pages, links to Markdown ToC and OCR text
- Read it with: `fetch("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maximosovsky/voprosy-metodologii/main/search-index.json")`
- Filter by author, year, or keyword in title

### 2. Browse a specific issue's table of contents

15 Markdown files at the repo root: `voprosy_metodologii_YYYY_N.md`
- Each lists sections, authors, titles and page numbers
- Read any of them directly from GitHub

### 3. Read full OCR text of an issue

Each issue folder contains `pages.html` — machine-recognized full text:
- Read via raw URL: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maximosovsky/voprosy-metodologii/main/voprosy_metodologii_1992_1-2/pages.html`
- The text is HTML with `<div class="pagebox">` containers — one per page
- Quality varies; for exact wording, refer to the scanned JPG

### 4. View original scanned pages

JPG files in each issue folder are named by page number (e.g. `0003.jpg` = page 3)
- View on GitHub or via raw URL: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maximosovsky/voprosy-metodologii/main/voprosy_metodologii_1992_1-2/0003.jpg`

### 5. Recommended workflow for LLM analysis

1. Load `search-index.json` to discover articles by topic/author
2. Read the relevant `.md` ToC file for context
3. Read `pages.html` for the full text
4. Cross-reference with JPG scans for verification

## Docs

- [search-index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maximosovsky/voprosy-metodologii/main/search-index.json): structured catalog (201 articles)
- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maximosovsky/voprosy-metodologii/main/llms-full.txt): complete issue-by-issue catalog
- [README.md](https://github.com/maximosovsky/voprosy-metodologii#readme): human-oriented documentation
